fusions.name: Many-Eyed Dart
fusions.desc: Fires a dart of water into the first enemy it meets for 7 damage, with a 35% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Silver Flash
fusions.desc: Flashes silver, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles that ignores their resistances. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Watching School
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds. An escort of water fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lidless Watch
fusions.desc: At night, your damage rises by 12%. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
